comments: Listed by A khu ching shes rab rgya mtsho in his Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 514, No. 11074: chos kyi ye shes kyi bslab btus 'grel pa). A manuscript of a "bSlab btus 'grel chen" ascribed to Chos kyi ye shes preserved at rGyal rtsel dpal 'khor chos sde dgon (ID:7359) is possibly an instance of this work.
